svg.title: A negative vertical scale turns a local minimum into a local maximum
svg.desc: The original quadratic f of x equals x minus two squared plus three has local minimum at two, three. Define g of x as negative two times f of three x plus five. The new input is two thirds and the output is negative one. Its stationary point is a local maximum because the vertical scale is negative. In general, for g of x equals A f of B x plus C with nonzero A and B, a point u,v maps to u over B, A v plus C. Negative A swaps maximum and minimum; a nonzero horizontal scale changes the input coordinate.
